subject: Request: extra evaluation credits and holdback for upcoming RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Asha Mehra <asha@supercart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra evaluation credits for SuperCart RFP

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the exec team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the cost controls you showed. We're running a tight bake-off across three vendors and I need to ask for two favors to keep Redwood in the running:

1) Can you extend our trial period by two weeks (current end date is May 3)?
2) We'd also like an incremental credit allocation specifically reserved for the RFP tests — something that can be drawn down only during the 10-day bake-off window.

We typically ask vendors to provide a modest escrow-style credit (just tokens for evaluation, not production) so the procurement team can validate throughput and edge-case prompts without billing surprises. If you could propose a number (or a small range) and any terms you need, I can take it to procurement immediately.

Appreciate it — target decision date is May 6.

Best,
Asha Mehra
Head of ML Integrations
SuperCart

Attachment: supercart-eval-sow.docx (SOW outline for bake-off)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Mehra <asha@supercart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra evaluation credits for SuperCart RFP

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I'm looping in Marissa (AE) and Neha (Sales Ops) to size an appropriate allocation and cover the administrative side.

Provisionally we can offer an "evaluation escrow" up to $5k equivalent in tokens for the 10-day bake-off, plus a 2-week extension on the trial. We typically place a usage cap and require that the credit be used for evaluation activities only; production usage transitions back to standard billing.

Neha — can you confirm whether we can do the $5k cap under SC-2027-RFP-1379 and what the internal approval path looks like? Also, is there a standard credit memo or DocuSign flow we should use so procurement gets the paperwork?

Asha — if $5k looks too low, tell us a target and we can iterate.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extra evaluation credits for SuperCart RFP

Jordan / Marissa — FYI and thumbs-up in principle. Sales Ops is ok to provision a limited evaluation credit with following guardrails: 

- Credit amount: $6,000 equivalent (tokens)
- Window: 10 consecutive days during the bake-off; trial extension of +2 weeks beyond current end date
- Usage: evaluation-only flag; any production calls beyond eval will be billed normally
- Holdback: $1,000 retained as a contingency until completion of the bake-off and a short validation call confirming the credit was used for evaluation tasks (to prevent misuse)

I'll prepare an internal credit memo and a one-page addendum for procurement. For speed, we can use DocuSign template "eval-credit-addendum-v2" and attach it to the HubSpot deal.

Notes: if procurement needs an invoice-level rebate instead of a credit, that requires finance approval and will take longer; we should avoid that if they want a fast decision.

Attaching draft of the approval for signatures: credit-approval-draft.pdf

Neha Kapoor
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-approval-draft.pdf

Asha — great to meet you (virtually) in the demo. Quick summary and next steps: 

- We're prepared to issue a $6k evaluation credit with the 10-day reserve window and a 2-week trial extension. $1k will be held as contingency and released after a short validation call.
- Action items for SuperCart: confirm the bake-off dates (start/end) and identify the single technical contact for the validation call. Please reply to this thread by EOD Thursday (May 6) so procurement can complete the purchase order.
- I'll drop the DocuSign addendum into the HubSpot record (Deal SC-2027-RFP-1379) and loop in procurement if needed.

If that all sounds good we'll get the DocuSign out today and the credit applied upon signature.

Best,
